item.description:
### Type your PIN
The PIN screen takes the keyboard now: type the digits, Delete to correct. Clicking still works.
### Links no longer lock the app
Opening Report Site — or any link in Profile — left an empty panel behind in the app. Coming back from the browser, it sat over the PIN screen and made the PIN impossible to enter. Links now open straight in your browser.
### Cleaner, calmer popups
- The backdrop behind a popup is clear glass, not a grey sheet, and the screen behind it stays quiet. - The Emergency Code sheet has a close button. - A whole Profile row is clickable, not only its text.
### Smaller fixes
- Parental no longer shows an error when you have not added a child yet. - The Safe Internet setup shows it working on a Mac.
